text_en: The Lord summoned Moses and spoke to him from the tent of meeting, saying:
text_cn: 上主叫了梅瑟来，由会幕中训示他说：

text_en: Speak to the people of Israel and say to them: When any of you bring an offering of livestock to the Lord , you shall bring your offering from the herd or from the flock.
text_cn: “你告诉以色列子民说：你们中若有人愿意由家畜中给上主奉献祭品。应以牛羊作你们的祭品。

text_en: If the offering is a burnt offering from the herd, you shall offer a male without blemish; you shall bring it to the entrance of the tent of meeting, for acceptance in your behalf before the Lord .
text_cn: 若有人献牛作全燔（fán）祭，该献一头无瑕的公牛，牵到会幕门口，为在上主面前蒙受悦纳；

text_en: You shall lay your hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be acceptable in your behalf as atonement for you.
text_cn: 先按手在全燔祭牲的头上，使祭牲蒙受悦纳，代自己赎罪。

text_en: The bull shall be slaughtered before the Lord ; and Aaron’s sons the priests shall offer the blood, dashing the blood against all sides of the altar that is at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 以后在上主面前宰了那牛，亚郎的儿子司祭们，应奉献牲血，将血洒在会幕门口的祭坛的四周。

text_en: The burnt offering shall be flayed and cut up into its parts.
text_cn: 奉献者剥去祭牲的皮，将牺牲切成块。

text_en: The sons of the priest Aaron shall put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.
text_cn: 亚郎的儿子司祭们先将火放在祭坛上，火上摆上木柴；

text_en: Aaron’s sons the priests shall arrange the parts, with the head and the suet, on the wood that is on the fire on the altar;
text_cn: 然后亚郎的儿子司祭们，将成块的肉、头和脂肪，摆在祭坛火上的木柴上。

text_en: but its entrails and its legs shall be washed with water. Then the priest shall turn the whole into smoke on the altar as a burnt offering, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the Lord .
text_cn: 奉献者应用水将内脏和小腿洗净；司祭将这一切放在祭坛上焚烧，作为全燔祭，作为中悦上主的馨香火祭。

text_en: If your gift for a burnt offering is from the flock, from the sheep or goats, your offering shall be a male without blemish.
text_cn: 若有人献羊作全燔祭，不论是绵羊，或是山羊，该献一头无瑕的公羊。

text_en: It shall be slaughtered on the north side of the altar before the Lord , and Aaron’s sons the priests shall dash its blood against all sides of the altar.
text_cn: 应在上主面前，祭坛的北边将它宰了；亚郎的儿子司祭们，应将血洒在祭坛的四周。

text_en: It shall be cut up into its parts, with its head and its suet, and the priest shall arrange them on the wood that is on the fire on the altar;
text_cn: 然后奉献者应将祭牲切成块，司祭将成块的肉、头和脂肪，摆在祭坛火上的木柴上。

text_en: but the entrails and the legs shall be washed with water. Then the priest shall offer the whole and turn it into smoke on the altar; it is a burnt offering, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the Lord .
text_cn: 那人应用水将内脏和小腿洗净；司祭将这一切，放在祭坛上焚烧，作为全燔祭，作为中悦上主的馨香火祭。

text_en: If your offering to the Lord is a burnt offering of birds, you shall choose your offering from turtledoves or pigeons.
text_cn: 若有人给上主献飞禽作全燔祭，该献斑鸠或雏鸽作祭品。

text_en: The priest shall bring it to the altar and wring off its head, and turn it into smoke on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out against the side of the altar.
text_cn: 司祭应将它带到祭坛前，扭断它的头，放在祭坛上焚烧；先把它的血靠在祭坛的旁边挤尽，

text_en: He shall remove its crop with its contents and throw it at the east side of the altar, in the place for ashes.
text_cn: 然后那人将嗉（sù）囊和羽毛拔去，丢在祭坛东边倒灰的地方。

text_en: He shall tear it open by its wings without severing it. Then the priest shall turn it into smoke on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire; it is a burnt offering, an offering by fire of pleasing odor to the Lord .
text_cn: 然后司祭将牺牲由两翼的中间撕开，但不可分离；放在祭坛火上的木柴上焚烧，作为全燔祭，作为中悦上主的馨香火祭。
